name: Dynamic Chunk Generation with Radius
definition: A dynamic generation approach where the world is generated around the player based on a radius value, using a dictionary to manage chunk states (KEEP, DRAW, DONE) to handle creation and deletion.
summary: Dynamic Chunk Generation with Radius manages voxel chunks via spherical distance culling, differing from grid scanners by calculating set differences to load and unload chunks based on spatial radius and lifecycle states.
